headline: Great books don’t have an expiration date.
description: Re:Read brings overlooked books back into print and introduces readers to new work worth discovering. We’re building our first collection, American Myths.
collectionBody: Our first collection is taking shape. We’re researching overlooked stories and new writing about the figures who shape the American imagination. No titles have been announced yet.
submissionBody: Submissions aren’t open yet. We’ll share details when there’s a formal reading process.
